subject.title: [Feature]: `announceTarget` option for sub-agent completion announce routing

question: Should OpenClaw add a public native subagent completion-routing contract named `announceTarget: "channel" | "parent"`, and should it be available both per-spawn and as `agents.defaults.subagents.announceTarget`?
rationale: The requested behavior adds model-facing tool/config surface and changes whether completion events wake parent sessions or deliver to external channels, which repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive product direction.

options.title: Approve per-spawn plus config default
options.body: Add `announceTarget` to `sessions_spawn` and `agents.defaults.subagents`, default it to current channel behavior, and route `parent` completions into the requester session without direct channel delivery.

options.title: Approve per-spawn only
options.body: Add only an explicit per-call override to enable orchestrator-controlled handoffs while avoiding a new global config default.

options.title: Decline native routing for now
options.body: Keep depth-based completion delivery and leave users on explicit callback or narrower follow-up patterns until a broader orchestration direction is chosen.

recommendation.title: Approve per-spawn plus config default
recommendation.body: Add `announceTarget` to `sessions_spawn` and `agents.defaults.subagents`, default it to current channel behavior, and route `parent` completions into the requester session without direct channel delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest merged-history connection to `sessions_spawn`, subagent announce delivery, and the config/tool surfaces that would need the product decision.
